desc:
Welcome to Duels! 🔫🔪

Show 'em who's boss in a fast-paced combat where aim and reflexes are everything. Do you actually have the AIM to survive or are you just all talk?

🔥 GAME MODES:
⚔️ 1v1 Duels (Prove who's the best)
👥 Team Battles: 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, and even 5v5!
🗺️ COMING SOON: Epic new maps!

🎮 CONTROLS:
[Left Click / R2]: Shoot (Gun) / Slash (Knife)
[E Key / L2 or Y on Console]: Throw Knife

✨ FEATURES:

- Smooth combat system
- Fast matchmaking
- Global Leaderboard

👍 LIKE and FAVORITE if you want more maps and weapons! It really helps us keep pushing updates.
🔔 Join the group, get codes, and be part of the community.
